title: pack
description: EchoForge unified pack manifest. Supersedes object_pack_manifest.schema.json and hard_negative_pack.schema.json with a single typed card_refs object that maps document-kind discriminators to file-path arrays. Co-exists with current manifests via the loader's `schema_version` discriminator (current manifests stay valid until the explicit migration window closes). Provides `pack_dependencies` for cross-pack references (e.g. detector pack depending on radar pack for `intended_sensor_archetypes`). Strict-open: each pack declares its own license + provenance + validation envelope.

id.description: Pack id of form 'pack.<slug>'. Globally unique across the org's pack inventory.

schema_version.description: Pack manifest schema version for the current unified pack contract.

card_refs.description: Typed card references. Each entry is an array of file paths (relative to the pack root) that the loader validates against the named schema. All keys optional; missing keys mean the pack ships zero cards of that kind.

card_slugs.description: Optional flat list of card slugs (slug-only, no kind discriminator) for quick lookup. Loader builds this automatically from card_refs at validation time.

pack_dependencies.description: Other packs this pack references (e.g. detector cards depending on radar platform cards for `intended_sensor_archetypes`).

validation_tier.description: Pack-level validation tier; individual cards may declare their own tier in their `validation` envelope. The pack-level tier is the lower bound on all cards in the pack.

superseded_by.description: If this pack is superseded by a newer pack, the loader logs a warning and prefers the successor for non-test contexts.

source_status.description: Mirrors object_pack_manifest / hard_negative_pack source_status field for back-compat.
